snippet.title: American Gold Rush Trailer | Free Demo at Steam Next Fest, Early Access November 2026
snippet.description:
Chase your fortune in the hills of Dahlonega, Georgia, 1829. Wishlist American Gold Rush on Steam today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5092140/

Free demo: Steam Next Fest, October 19-26, 2026
Early Access: November 2026

Twenty years before California, the first American gold rush broke out in the north Georgia hills. Folks came from every direction with empty pockets, big plans and red clay on their boots.

American Gold Rush is a pixel art adventure set in that moment. Make your way in a frontier boomtown, break new ground, and see how far your luck and your nerve will carry you.

PLAY THE DEMO
The free demo arrives during Steam Next Fest, October 19-26, 2026. Wishlist the game now so you do not miss it. Every wishlist helps a small team get noticed on Steam.

COMING TO EARLY ACCESS
American Gold Rush launches in Steam Early Access in November 2026.

MADE BY REAL PEOPLE
American Gold Rush is made by a dad and his kids in Georgia. Every piece of art and every sound in the game was made by real artists, not AI.

LINKS
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5092140/
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/qfz8hHJzEj

MUSIC
"Confronting The Man In Black" by Harvey Carman, from Wild West Music
https://composercarman.itch.io/wild-west-music
Licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Excerpted and shortened for this trailer.

All gameplay was captured from the game itself during our live dev streams.
